resources.string: Say a place with the microphone button in search. The speech is recognised on this phone, with no internet connection and no Google or other speech service.
Not installed. Until you install it, the microphone button uses the speech recogniser of your phone, if it has one.
Installed. The microphone button works offline.
Installed, but this phone cannot run it. The microphone button uses your phone\'s own recogniser.

Your voice never leaves this phone. The model file is downloaded once from huggingface.co, which sees your IP address and the download, nothing you say. The microphone is used only while the listening screen is open.
The download was interrupted. Tap download again to resume.
Not enough free storage for the model.
The downloaded file did not match its checksum and was discarded.
The speech engine could not load the model on this phone.
